title: Python IDE PyCharm Integrated with Cardano Development Support

ms.promise:
Scope and Requirements Document: 
A detailed document defining the scope of the project, including features, functionality, and technical requirements. This document serves as a blueprint for the development process and ensures alignment with stakeholders' expectations.
ms.criteria: The document is published on Github, accessible to the public and it contains scope of the project including features, functionalities and technical requirements.
ms.report:
We are very excited to deliver this key project for Cardano Developers Community. We are delayed in submitting this milestone however it is worth as we have done extensive research and now the document is very concrete in technical approach. 
We have produced Scope and design document for following features, 
・Syntax Highlighting and Code Completion
・Cardano Blockchain Explorer API Integration
・Smart Contract Deployment/Connecting Node from PyCharm 
・Wallet Management - example Creating Wallet 
・Debugging Tools

Link to the Scope and design document https://github.com/AIQUANT-Tech/CardanoPyC/blob/main/DesignDocs/CardanoPyC-Scope_Design_Document.pdf
We have setup public repository for source code for future use and added documentation folder and document link there.
https://github.com/AIQUANT-Tech/CardanoPyC/
